press_references.value: BigHat Biosciences and Lilly Collaborate to Advance AI-Driven Antibody Therapeutics

partnership_announcements.description: BigHat Biosciences and Eli Lilly have announced a strategic collaboration to advance AI-driven antibody therapeutics. The partnership combines BigHat's ML-powered Milliner platform with Lilly's drug discovery expertise to develop next-generation antibodies for up to two therapeutic programs. This collaboration aims to enhance antibody functionality and improve patient outcomes in chronic disease treatment.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: BigHat Biosciences is engaged in developing polypeptides and variants that bind to selectin molecules, as described in 'P- and e-selectin-binding compositions and methods of use thereof.' Their work also includes pH-selective anti-CD3 antibodies with improved binding affinity in acidic environments, as detailed in 'Ph-selective anti-cd3 antibodies and use of the same,' and antigen-binding domains targeting the SARS-CoV(-2) spike glycoprotein, as outlined in 'Sars-cov(-2) spike glycoprotein-binding domains and polypeptides comprising the ….' These efforts highlight research in antibody engineering and targeted protein therapeutics.

overview_description.description: BigHat is a developer of an AI-guided protein therapeutic platform used to integrate antibody characterization lab with machine learning technologies to engineer molecules with more complex functions and better biophysical properties. The company is applying these design capabilities to develop new generations of safer and more effective treatments for patients suffering from today’s most challenging diseases.
